messages:
maya: heads up — p95 spike on reserved-pool-6 started ~10:02 UTC, seeing evictions and quota errors :rotating_light:
ethan: copying logs. any chance this ties to the kernel-selection tweak in the 09:45 deploy?
sara: yes. deploy at 09:45 adjusted kernel-pruning heuristics (fast-path only for seq<128). attaching profiler snapshot and kv-cache stats.
ops-bot: [alert] reserved-pool-6 GPU/CPU saturation >95% at 2026-03-18T10:02:13Z
ryan: paste profiler + kv stats pls
sara: ```
# profiler
kernel_select: cpu +42%
batch_assembler: wait +28%
kv_cache_miss_rate: 0.37 -> 0.62
concurrent_reqs: 420 -> 980
avg_seq_len: 210
```
sara: kv cache lines: cache_evictions:1254, prefix_hits:6500->2800, ttl_expirations:0
li: batching heuristics started grouping long sequences with short ones. kernel selector falls back to slower kernel and kv miss spikes
maya: noisy neighbor? any single-tenant burst on pool-6?
ethan: telemetry shows tenant-team-dash had sustained heavy job, ~30k tokens/hr, pinned slots, prewarm=false
ryan: tenant was running high-temp reranker; kernel selection frequently picks float32 fallback
maya: mitigation options?
li: 1) flip prewarm=true for that tenant (config change)
li: 2) add +2 nodes to reserved-pool-6 (manual scale)
li: 3) rollback kernel-selection heuristic (requires deploy ~15m)
sara: I can enable prewarm now
ethan: opening infra scale ticket, ETA ~8m
maya: and add routing rule to shift new requests to pool-7 if compatible
ryan: shifting 20% new traffic -> pool-7 now
ops-bot: [deploy] routing change completed at 2026-03-18T10:07:01Z
sara: after prewarm + routing: kv_miss_rate -> 0.25, p95 latency trending down
maya: batch_assembler backlog still high. backlog peaked 600 now 120
li: root cause: heuristic allowed mixing long/short seqs causing kernel fallback and kv hotset thrash. contributing: quota tightness and placement not isolating tenant
maya: action items:
- rollback heuristic PR (ethan)
- per-tenant slot caps for reserved pools (product + infra)
- default prewarm for sustained tenants (runtime)
- autoscale trigger when kv_miss > 0.5 (sre)
- add alert for kernel_select CPU regression >30% (eng-runtime)
ethan: rollback PR opened
sara: capturing perf traces, flamegraphs, eval set
ryan: filing support ticket with tenant-team-dash asking to move heavy batch jobs to dedicated-only queue
maya: marking SEV2. timeline doc started in incidents/1785046789-timeline.md
ops-bot: [alert resolved] p95 back to normal at 2026-03-18T10:41:02Z
maya: thanks everyone. postmortem tomorrow, include kernel selection flamegraphs and profiling artifacts
ethan: +1
li: +1 :thumbsup:
